lines.3: But someone had just told me she loved me exactly as I was.
lines.4: Yoshimi had shown me all the good in me.
lines.5: ...That's right. I'd been so desperate to tear myself down and give up,
lines.6: but I didn't have to give up at all.
lines.7: I could make up for everything I lacked from here on out.
lines.9: That spark smoldering deep in my chest was the flame of my longing for the Princess.
lines.10: Even when she rejected me that day, I'd simply accepted her side of it and given up.
lines.11: I still hadn't said any of the things I wanted to say.
lines.12: There would be time to get crushed after that.
lines.17: 「Just hearing you say all that made me feel so much better.」
lines.22: 「I was an idiot to give up on my own when there was still so much I wanted to tell her.」
lines.23: 「I'm going to ask the Princess to start over with me.」
lines.25: 「Your feelings made me so happy I could cry.」
lines.26: 「But I love the Princess just as strongly.」
lines.28: 「I'm going to see her one more time.」
lines.29: 「So I can't go out with you, Yoshimi.」
lines.31: 「That simple, single-minded side of you... is one of the things I like, too.」
lines.33: 「Ellie's probably in the student council room.」
lines.35: 「Your words gave me the courage I needed.」
lines.37: putting every ounce of gratitude I had into it.
lines.38: And before I knew it, I was running.
lines.39: Leaving Yoshimi behind moments after she confessed to me.
lines.40: I'd called myself a clown, and now I'd made a clown of her.
lines.41: But even if everyone condemned me as the lowest of the low,
lines.42: I couldn't give up on the Princess.
lines.43: That was my heart's honest answer.
lines.44: All I could do was act on it.
lines.47: 「Crabby... I mean, Kanisawa. The lacrosse club has requested emergency reinforcements. Proceed to the field at once.」
lines.48: The Princess's personal announcement rang through the school.
lines.49: If that speaker was in use,
lines.51: then she had to be here.
lines.52: 「Hm? What's wrong, Tsushima? You look frantic.」
lines.53: 「Is it just you in here, Princess?」
lines.57: I didn't need any fancy words.
lines.58: My honest feelings would be enough.
lines.59: Click. I locked the student council room door.
lines.60: 「Wait... Why are you locking the door?」
lines.61: 「Because I want the two of us to talk honestly, in private.」
